sections.heading: Quick Reference
sections.gist: table columns: Kernel, Builder Function, API Style, Dtypes, Key Feature

sections.heading: 1. Normalization Kernels
sections.gist: Computes `LayerNorm(x) = (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) * gamma + beta` for each row.

sections.heading: 2. Softmax Kernel
sections.gist: Computes row-wise softmax: `softmax(x)_i = exp(x_i - max(x)) / sum(exp(x - max(x)))`.

sections.heading: 3. GEMM Kernel
sections.gist: MFMA 16x16-based GEMM with B-matrix preshuffle layout: `C[M,N] = A[M,K] @ B[N,K]^T`.

sections.heading: 4. Shared Utilities
sections.gist: Reusable warp and block reduction functions (used by normalization and softmax kernels).

```
What operation do you need?
│
├── Normalization
│   ├── Need bias (beta) term? → LayerNorm (layernorm_kernel.py)
│   └── No bias term?         → RMSNorm (rmsnorm_kernel.py)
│
├── Softmax
│   └── Row-wise softmax      → Softmax (softmax_kernel.py)
│
├── Matrix Multiply (GEMM)
│   ├── Standard GEMM (uniform precision)
│   │   ├── FP8 / INT8 / INT4(W4A8) / FP16 / BF16 / FP4
│   │   └── → compile_preshuffle_gemm_a8()
│   │
│   └── Uses new @flyc.kernel API
│       └── See kernels/preshuffle_gemm.py
│
├── MoE (Mixture of Experts)
│   ├── Blockscale MoE (gate+up+reduce)
│   │   └── → kernels/moe_blockscale_2stage.py
│   └── Standard MoE (fp8/f16/bf16/int8/int4)
│       └── → kernels/moe_gemm_2stage.py
│
└── Building blocks
    ├── Warp/block reduction     → reduce.py
    ├── MFMA epilogue selection  → mfma_epilogues.py
    └── Preshuffle data movement → mfma_preshuffle_pipeline.py
```
